strings.A mod changes the deck itself: the look: A mod changes the deck itself: the look (colours, shapes, fonts) and page features. Put the mod folder into mods on the PC and tap «Rescan» (or restart the deck) — the deck will show «before / after». A mod with code (JS) runs on the phone with the deck page's rights — install only trusted ones.
strings.A tile — menu: edit, rename, to group, d: A tile — menu: edit, rename, to group, delete (move your finger — drag). A mode on the home screen — its colour, icon and grid.
strings.Arrange the windows on the PC the way yo: Arrange the windows on the PC the way you want and mark them. The tile will put the windows back in place, restore minimised ones and launch closed ones.
strings.Drag a tile to move it · pencil — name,: Drag a tile to move it · pencil — name, icon, colour · cross — delete your mode

strings.Slide around the wheel — hue. Sliders —: Slide around the wheel — hue. Sliders — saturation and brightness. «Done» — the colour goes to the mode and your colours.
strings.Tap a language — it downloads from the c: Tap a language — it downloads from the catalogue and turns on. Hold it to delete the pack.
strings.Tap a preset color to replace it with yo: Tap a preset colour to replace it with your own. Tap your own to adjust it. ✕ — remove your colour.

strings.The rainbow circle — any color: hue whee: The rainbow circle — any colour: hue wheel, saturation and brightness.
strings.To change a mode's color, icon, name or: To change a mode's colour, icon, name or tile size, hold it on the home screen.
strings.View only: modes, player, visualizer, di: View only: modes, player, visualiser, diagnostics — no pressing
strings.Your own deck look without code: tile sh: Your own deck look without code: tile shape and colours, background (gradient, pattern, photo), dock, font — visible on the deck right away.
strings.«All» changes the whole color, 1–3 — one: «All» changes the whole colour, 1–3 — one part: 1 — middle, 3 — edges. «+» — any custom colour.
